text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Hit me. One more card.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Ha! You want to hit? You do know
there's a fine
line between courage and
recklessness, right?
You're going to bust
for sure.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Gee, thanks for your concern. Now I
know who to
talk to next time I want a
lesson in settling for
small victories.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Fine by me. Actually, I was just thinking it's about time I taught you a harsh lesson in reality.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Hmph. I'm going to wipe that smug look
right off
your face.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
H-hey! This looks like it could be bad
news! We
need to go call a teacher or
something!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Visiting the cafeteria, I happen upon
some
commotion unfolding.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer! Can you come here for a
sec? Some
big trouble's brewing here!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
This is bad! The showdown between
those two is
getting way out of hand...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
They're wagering their whole futures!
The loser
has to drop out of the
academy!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
This isn't a game anymore! I need to put
a stop to
this at once!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Quit raining on our parade. I'm on fire
here, so
just butt out.
choice_data_list: 2人とも落ち着いて！勝負を止めよう！

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, keep out of it. Let's do this,
Nakayama.
Time to switch dealer.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
I can't wait to see you screw up your
hand and
bust.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
You're one punk of a kid, you know
that? I'm
going to put an end to this
right now.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Things are so heated that neither of
them are
paying me any attention!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But I can't just stand by and do nothing.
I have to
stop them!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama & Sirius
text_block_list.text: ...What?
choice_data_list: お、俺も勝負に参加する……！
わ、私も勝負に参加する……！

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: However...
choice_data_list: 俺が勝ったら退学を撤回してもらうぞ！
私が勝ったら退学を撤回してもらうから！

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Ha ha ha! How low you've fallen! What
happened
to all that confidence you had
a minute ago?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm whooped over and over without ever
coming
close to winning. These two are
just too good!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
I think it's time you called it quits,
Trainer. Unless
you're enjoying this
losing streak you're on.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But I can't afford to back down.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The game is blackjack. The objective is
to build a
hand of cards with a total
value as close to
twenty-one as possible
without going over.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Right now, I have sixteen. It seems a bit
weak, but
if I add another card I might
go over.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I have to win this game! But should I hit
or stand?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm dealt a ten, meaning I've gone over

twenty-one and busted...
choice_data_list: ヒット！カードをもう1枚！
スタンド。カードをストップするしかない

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Ah ha ha! That really blew up in your
face! Sure
was fun to watch, though!
choice_data_list: ああああああああぁぁぁぁぁっ……！？

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Looks like it's our win.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Haha! Hahaha! What a pitiful sight!
Ahaha!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: I've got twenty-one. That's a blackjack.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Same here.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sixteen versus two hands of twenty-one.
Well,
there goes the victory I needed so
desperately...
choice_data_list: ああああああああぁぁぁぁぁっ……！？

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Haha! Hahaha! What a pitiful sight!
Ahaha!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Ha ha ha ha!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Sigh...

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Tch... Given the look on your face after
that
spectacular loss, I've decided to
withdraw for
today.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: I'm saying that you killed the mood.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Besides, we already got our fill from
watching you
lose.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Hmph.
choice_data_list: ……熱い勝負はレースでするといいよ

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: I'll think about it.
